content:
maria: FYI we flipped continuous-saga=true on a small canary at 11:20 and saw short-request tail latency regress (p95 95 -> ~220ms). Dash: https://dash/reports/ci/3299991234 :thinking:

sam: Any single noisy tenant? errors?

maria: Cross-tenant, no errors. GPUs look healthy.

alex: Logs indicate saga commit path is holding kvcache entries until manager ack, triggering eviction churn and cold misses. Snippet:
```
microbatch_saga: commit_start tenant=acct-42 req=0x7fae
kvcache: evict key=model-x:slot-11
microbatch_saga: waiting on postCommitFuture req=0x7fae
kvcache: miss tenant=acct-42 key=model-x:slot-11
```

patrick: Canary used window_ms=8, max_coalesce=64. If commit latency increases, coalesce windows desync and split microbatches.

maria: Lowering window_ms helped p50 but p95 stayed high. Toggling saga off returned tail to baseline.

sam: Quick mitigations?

alex: Options: 1) async early-ack for tiny requests (seq_len <= 8), 2) avoid strong refs during commit (weak refs or staging), 3) gate saga for latency-sensitive tenants. Async has ordering risk.

patrick: I'll audit kvcache pin lifecycle. Weak refs or short-lived staging buffer could reduce eviction pressure.

infra-bot: Noted elevated eviction_rate on node g-102 at 11:21. Logs: https://logs/redwood/g-102/3299991234

deploy-bot: Canary roll 3299991234 -> saga enabled; rolled back on canary-2 after perf spike.

sam: Proposed next steps: run matrix for window_ms in {2,4,8} x commit_async {on,off}; add histogram saga_hold_time_ms; prototype commit_async gated by seq_len <= 8 and sampled ordering validator; disable saga on hosted until safety proven.

maria: I'll open short RFC/experiment and schedule sync. Alex takes commit_async prototype; Patrick owns kvcache audit.

alex: +1. I'll add sampled linearizability checks to the prototype.

patrick: Will try weak-ref path in kvcache and measure eviction_rate impact.

maria: Thanks all, syncing tomorrow. :thumbsup:
